patch_description:
This crossover keeps the empirically stronger behavior of the current program: wall targets are selected primarily by nearby standing distance without the additional adjacency/pet penalties that reduced the measured score in the inspiration program.

The implementation is streamlined with fixed-size grids for per-turn reservations and BFS visitation. This removes repeated vector scans for tentative walls and move conflicts, while preserving the same strip-partition construction strategy, interaction protocol, and safety checks. BFS uses timestamp visitation and stores the first direction directly, avoiding parent-grid initialization and path reconstruction on every search.
